# task-6db1dc74: Connected zero-cluster recoloring

## Rule
For the binary-looking grid, identify 4-connected components of color 0 (orthogonal neighbors only). Recolor every cell in each component of size 2 or more to color 8. Leave every isolated single-cell 0 unchanged. Preserve all 1s and all other cells.

Do not use diagonal connectivity: zero cells touching only at corners are separate components. Do not recolor all zeros indiscriminately.

## Evidence and validation
A 13x13 demonstration showed multi-cell zero groups changed to 8 while singleton zeros remained 0. The tested 13x13 instance was solved correctly with this rule on the first submission.

## Procedure
1. Copy the input grid.
2. Flood-fill zero cells using up/down/left/right adjacency.
3. For each component with at least two cells, set all its cells to 8.
4. Leave size-one components as 0.
5. Check dimensions, preserve the original 1s, and emit the exact resulting grid."
}
